keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Iron Gomis (Troyes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Angers 1, Troyes 0. Prosper Peter (Angers) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Amine Sbaï with a cross.
First Half ends, Angers 1, Troyes 0.
Second Half begins Angers 1, Troyes 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Prosper Peter (Angers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Angers 2, Troyes 0. Amine Sbaï (Angers) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Amine El Ouazzani.
